'''CT-9/85''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was stationed on the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|supercruiser]] [[Nexu (starship)|''Nexu'']], where he served as communications [[Technician/Legends|technician]] under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Arikakon Baraka]]. During that [[Galactic Standard Calendar|year]], the ''Nexu'' was sent to [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] in order to support [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had been [[Mission to Ord Cestus|dispatched]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to stop the production of [[JK-13 security droid|JK-13 droids]]. Stationed in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Ord Cestus, CT-9/85 received a transmission from from a [[Jangotat|clone]] on the surface, who ordered an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] on his position. CT-9/85 informed Baraka of the message, and the ''Nexu'' then [[Laser/Legends|fired]] on the position, wiping out the [[Five Families of Cestus Cybernetics]], an organization allied with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What is that location?''"<br />"''We show it as a blip on the power grid. Might be some kind of secret base.''"<br />"''Then let's get on with it.|CT-9/85 and Admiral Arikakon Baraka|<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />}}
CT-9/85<ref name="The Cestus Deception" /> was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="clone troopers" /> who were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> to fight for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> CT-9/85 served as a [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] communications [[Technician/Legends|technician]] on the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|supercruiser]] [[Nexu (starship)|''Nexu'']], under the command of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Arikakon Baraka]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], the ''Nexu'' was stationed over [[Vandor-3]] for a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] training program on the planet. Shortly afterward, the ''Nexu'' was dispatched to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] in order to support [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in their [[Mission to Ord Cestus|mission]] to stop the production of [[JK-13 security droid]]s on the planet's surface. While CT-9/85 remained with the ''Nexu'' in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], the Republic ground forces ran into trouble and ordered that the ''Nexu'' carry out an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] on [[ChikatLik]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Ord Cestus.<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />

Soon after, CT-9/85 received a signal from [[Jangotat|one]] of the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] accompanying Fisto and Kenobi on priority sequence. When CT-9/85 informed Baraka of the signal, the Mon Calamari went to CT-9/85's station and asked for the data content of the message that was contained in the signal. The message stated that the ''Nexu'' should change the coordinates for the orbital bombardment to a location east of the [[Kibo Lake]], on Ord Cestus. After Baraka checked the position, he ordered the ''Nexu'' to open [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on the designated location, wiping out the [[Five Families of Cestus Cybernetics]], an organization in league with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Fisto and Kenobi were then able to complete the mission successfully.<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Trooper's calling the load in right on top of himself. Can't get more serious than that.|CT-9/85|<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />}}
CT-9/85 was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] veteran communications technician. He was skilled at his job, as he was able to quickly analyze the ARC [[Trooper/Legends|trooper's]] transmission and give it to Admiral Baraka. When Baraka questioned the message's legitimacy, CT-9/85 assured him it was genuine, revealing that the [[Troop/Legends|trooper]] was calling for the bombardment on his own position&mdash;which he believed to be a very serious matter.<ref name="The Cestus Deception" /> As a Jango Fett clone,<ref name="clone troopers" /> CT-9/85 stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
CT-9/85 appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[The Cestus Deception]]'', written by [[Steven Barnes]].<ref name="The Cestus Deception" />
